title: US forces enter Iran by..?
description:

The resolution source will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: US special operations forces executed confirmed ground rescues of downed F-15E pilots inside Iranian territory on April 4-5, the first verified physical entries by active US military personnel since the 2026 Iran war erupted with US-Israel airstrikes on February 28. Qualifying under resolution criteria that include special ops but exclude aerial incursions or intelligence activities, these raids—bolstered by reports of SEAL Team Six involvement—have driven trader consensus toward near-certainty for short-term outcomes amid massive regional deployments of 82nd Airborne and Marine units. President Trump's ultimatums threaten infrastructure strikes over Strait of Hormuz blockades unless Iran capitulates, as Tehran rejects ceasefires and retaliates with missiles, with deadlines looming for potential escalation or diplomacy.

eventMetadata.context_description: California Gov. Gavin Newsom leads trader consensus at 24.1% implied probability for the 2028 Democratic presidential nomination on Polymarket, buoyed by a March 2026 Politico poll showing him dominating Kamala Harris in their home-state primary and his book tour stops in early states like New Hampshire, signaling national ambitions amid high market volume exceeding hundreds of millions. The wide-open field post-2024 reflects no declared candidates, with Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez at 8.3% drawing progressive support via social media energy, Sen. Jon Ossoff at 6.5% benefiting from Georgia's battleground status, and former VP Harris fading to 4.3% due to recent electoral baggage. Consolidation could hinge on 2026 midterm results elevating governors or senators, early fundraising edges, and party endorsements, though polls like recent New Hampshire surveys favoring Pete Buttigieg highlight market divergences from public opinion.

The Magic (42-36), fighting for better play-in positioning, hold home-court advantage at Kia Center and just rallied from 15 down to beat New Orleans, though they're shorthanded without Franz Wagner (ankle), Jonathan Isaac (knee), and Jett Howard (ankle), with Anthony Black upgraded to questionable (abdomen). Recent head-to-head favors Detroit 2-1 this season, but late lineup changes and end-of-season rest dynamics for the top seed could sway trader consensus on this low-stakes finale for the Pistons.

eventMetadata.context_description: Cleveland Cavaliers head to Memphis as playoff-clinched contenders at 49-29, facing a depleted Grizzlies squad sitting at 25-53 and long eliminated from postseason contention, in a late-regular-season clash marred by extensive injuries on both sides. The Cavs rule out stars Donovan Mitchell (left ankle sprain), James Harden (personal reasons), Max Strus (foot), Thomas Bryant (calf), and Dean Wade (ankle), while Memphis lacks Ja Morant (season-ending elbow UCL), Brandon Clarke (calf), Santi Aldama (knee surgery), Scotty Pippen Jr. (toe surgery), Zach Edey (ankle), and Kentavious Caldwell-Pope (finger). Cleveland rides a two-game win streak over Pacers and Warriors into Grizzlies' home court, where they've dominated recent head-to-heads including a 108-100 November victory, though load management could influence rotations in this meaningless finale.

No major injuries or withdrawals disrupt favorites, with practice rounds proceeding under dry weather; Morikawa's recent back issue tempers his 2.5% share. Historical Masters volatility underscores the competitive dynamics, rewarding course history and par-5 scoring.

eventMetadata.context_description: Trader consensus on Polymarket prices Robert F. Kennedy Jr. at 49% implied probability to secure the Republican presidential nomination in 2028, driven by his high-profile role as Health and Human Services Secretary pushing the "Make America Healthy Again" agenda, recent midterm travel to build grassroots support, and speculation fueled by family endorsements contradicting his own denials of a run.
